RE: time to chat?
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Nisha Deolalikar Thursday, September 30, 2021 at 8:30:07 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Beth Tritter
Hi Beth,
reat to hear from you! I hope you are well and enjoying USAID. I know PHCPI must miss you deeply, but I'm sure yc
e doing great things in the new rol
And of course, would be happy to chat next week. Do any of these times work?
• Monday: Flexible between 12:30pm PT-2:30pm PT / 3:30pm ET-5:30pm ET
• Tuesday: After 2pm PT / 5pm ET
• Wednesday: Between 9am-10am PT / 12pm-1pm ET
Talk soon!
Nisha
From: Beth Tritter <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Thursday, September 30, 2021 11:12 AM
To: Nisha Deolalikar < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: time to chat?
Nisha -
I hope all is well and that your fall has been lovely.
As you know, 1 moved over to USAID a few months ago, working on the COVID task force. We have some ideas that
emerged from last week's Presidential Summit that I wanted to share with you and chat about. Do you have time early
next week for a call?
Thanks so much,
Beth
